data.name: SoDA
data.abstract: Dataset of "Social Distancing Alert with Smartwatches"

intro_paper.title: Social Distancing Alert with Smartwatches
intro_paper.authors: Xin Wang, Xilei Wu, Huina Meng, Yu Fan, Jing Shi, Han Ding, Fei Wang

additional_info.summary:
The file name with the format of "I_J_K.mat".

I(1 - 10): the I-th subject.
J(1 - 18): the J-th action.
K(0 - 9): the K-th repetition.
Every mat file contains three keys:

accData(1, 3, sequence length): A sequence of the accelerometer readings.
gyrData (1, 3, sequence length): A sequence of the gyroscope readings.
label(1, sequence length): Action labels for each sample point.
additional_info.purpose: People would violate the social distancing practice unconsciously when they conduct some social activities such as handshaking, hugging, kissing on the face or forehead, etc. For preventing COVID-19 virus transmission, we collected recordings of accelerometers and gyroscopes to recognize activities that may violate social distancing practices.
additional_info.instances_represent: every instance is a time series of different social distancing actions
additional_info.recommended_data_splits: based on different needs, can split data into training-set/validation-set/testing-set
